newsitem.title: USA: Vermont Gov sees slow property tax reform.
newsitem.headline: Vermont Gov sees slow property tax reform.

text.p: Vermont Gov Howard Dean said this year's legislature will set in motion a course for dramatic change in education funding, but cautioned changes to the system of funding schools with local property taxes will not come overnight.
At a breakfast on Monday with members of the Lake Champlain Regional Chamber of Commerce, Dean noted even Democrats in the legislature have not agreed how to change the system.
The Gov also suggested tax breaks given to attract manufacturing facilities to Vermont should be extended to construction projects in downtown areas.

Dean said such a move would vitalize the state's towns, and discourage suburban sprawl. Dean told members of the Lake Champlain Regional Chamber of Commerce that any downtown project ought to have construction materials over $1 billion dollars exempted from taxes.
